name: datatug
description: DataTug CLI plugin: skills that teach AI agents how to use the datatug CLI for data exploration, dataset management, schema scanning, and query execution.

webDevHost.title: Development web UI host
webDevHost.description: Leave empty. Set it only when you run the DataTug web UI locally at http://datatug.localhost (or https, with an optional port, such as http://datatug.localhost:4200): "Open in DataTug" links to that exact address are then drawn. Any other value is ignored. Links to https://datatug.app are drawn either way.

agentId.title: DataTug agent ID
agentId.description: Optional. Your registered agent's ID (ag-..., from the DataTug web app). With it, and the space and project below, the plugin starts a DataTug agent session when a Claude Code session starts and ends it when the session ends, so "This session" approvals end with the conversation. The DATATUG_AGENT_ID environment variable takes precedence.

spaceId.title: DataTug space ID
spaceId.description: Optional. The space of the agent session (DATATUG_SPACE_ID takes precedence).

projectId.title: DataTug project ID
projectId.description: Optional. The project of the agent session (DATATUG_PROJECT_ID takes precedence).
